about: The evangelium of the formulary “13th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time, as Jesus was going to Jerusalem, He was passing through the midst of Samaria and Galilee. And as He was entering a certain village, ten leprous men met Him; they stood at a distance and raised their voice, saying: Jesus, Master, have mercy on us. When He saw them, He said: Go, show yourselves to the priests. And it came to pass that as they went, they were cleansed. But one of them, when he saw that he had been cleansed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice, and he fell on his face at His feet, giving thanks; and this man was a Samaritan. Then Jesus answered and said: Were not ten cleansed? And the nine, where are they? No one has been found to come back and give glory to God but this foreigner. And He said to him: Arise, go; for your faith has made you whole.
